Message.Name: Time Message
Message.Description: A Time message is sent whenever the source time for a unit passes over a second boundary.

Field.Name: Time
Field.Description: Number of whole seconds from midnight Eastern Time

Message.Name: Unit Clear Message
Message.Description: The Unit Clear message instructs feed recipients to clear all orders for the Cboe book in the unit specified in the Sequenced Unit Header. This message will be sent at startup each day.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Add Order Long Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display, 0 = Order is not aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote, 1 = Order is aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote

Message.Name: Add Order Short Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Short Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Short Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display, 0 = Order is not aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote, 1 = Order is aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote

Message.Name: Add Order Expanded Message
Message.Description: An Add Order message represents a newly accepted visible order on the Cboe book. Expanded version accommodates larger symbol sizes possible through the ISRA plan.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Day-specific identifier assigned to this order

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B = Buy Order S = Sell Order

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts being added to the book (may be less than the number entered).

Field.Name: Expanded Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The limit order price

Field.Name: Add Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display, 0 = Order is not aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote, 1 = Order is aggregated in the Cboe SIP quote

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Optionally specified. If specified, MPID (equities) or Executing Broker (options) of firm attributed to this quote. Alternatively “RTAL” for retail specified orders (equities). Space filled otherwise.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: BZX/EDGX Options Only (space filled on C2 Options and all equities markets). N = Non-Customer C = Customer

Message.Name: Order Executed Message
Message.Description: Order Executed messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Only (byte not sent in Equities) (Space): Normal Trade S: Spread trade

Message.Name: Order Executed at Price Size Message
Message.Description: Order Executed at Price/Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is executed in whole or in part at a different price than the limit price on the original Add Order message or the limit order price in the latest Modify Order message referencing the Order Id.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that was executed

Field.Name: Executed Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Remaining Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts remaining after the execution

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this execution. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Only (byte not sent in Equities) (Space): Normal Trade, S: Spread trade

Message.Name: Reduce Size Long Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced

Field.Name: Canceled Long Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts canceled

Message.Name: Reduce Size Short Message
Message.Description: Reduce Size messages are sent when a visible order on the Cboe book is partially reduced.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been reduced

Field.Name: Canceled Short Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts canceled

Message.Name: Modify Order Long Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered)

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify

Field.Name: Modify Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display, Bit 1 - Maintain Priority

Message.Name: Modify Order Short Message
Message.Description: The Modify Order message is sent whenever an open order is visibly modified. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has been modified

Field.Name: Short Quantity
Field.Description: Number of shares/contracts associated with this order after this modify (may be less than the number entered)

Field.Name: Short Price
Field.Description: The limit order price after this modify

Field.Name: Modify Flags
Field.Description: Bit 0 - Display, Bit 1 - Maintain Priority

Message.Name: Delete Order Message
Message.Description: The Delete Order message is sent whenever an open order is completely canceled. The Order Id refers to the Order Id of the original Add Order message.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Order Id of a previously sent Add Order message that has completely cancelled

Message.Name: Trade Long Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Only (byte not sent in Equities)

Message.Name: Trade Short Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side

Field.Name: Short Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Short Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Only (byte not sent in Equities)

Message.Name: Trade Expanded Message
Message.Description: The Trade message provides information about executions of non-displayed orders on the Cboe book and routed executions to other trading centers.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Order Id
Field.Description: Obfuscated Order ID or Order Id of the executed order.

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: Always B = Buy Order regardless of resting side

Field.Name: Long Quantity
Field.Description: Incremental number of shares/contracts executed

Field.Name: Expanded Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: The execution price of the order

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe generated day-unique execution identifier of this trade. Execution Id is also referenced in the Trade Break message.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: Options Only (byte not sent in Equities)

Message.Name: Trade Break Message
Message.Description: The Trade Break message is sent whenever an execution on Cboe is broken.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Execution Id
Field.Description: Cboe execution identifier of the execution that was broken. Execution Id refers to previously sent Order Executed or Trade message.

Message.Name: End of Session Message
Message.Description: The End of Session message is sent for each unit when the unit shuts down. No more sequenced messages will be delivered for this unit, but heartbeats from the unit may be received.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Message.Name: Symbol Mapping Message
Message.Description: A Symbol Mapping message is used to map the 6 character multicast feed symbol field to an OSI symbol. These messages are not sequenced (sequence = 0) and are sent continuously through the day at variable rates as bandwidth allows.

Field.Name: Feed Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: OSI Symbol
Field.Description: OSI Symbol

Field.Name: Symbol Condition
Field.Description: N = Normal, C = Closing Only

Message.Name: Trading Status Message
Message.Description: The Trading Status message is used to indicate the current trading status of a security. A Trading Status message will be sent whenever a security’s trading status changes.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Expanded Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: A, H, Q, S, T

Field.Name: Reserved1
Field.Description: Reserved

Field.Name: Reserved2
Field.Description: Reserved

Message.Name: Auction Update Message
Message.Description: Auction Update messages are used to disseminate Cboe price and size information during auctions for Cboe listed securities and for Cboe Market Close (CMC) crosses.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction type value

Field.Name: Reference Price
Field.Description: BBO Collared auction price

Field.Name: Buy Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on buy side at the Reference Price.

Field.Name: Sell Shares
Field.Description: Number of shares on sell side at the Reference Price.

Field.Name: Indicative Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book and the continuous book would match.

Field.Name: Auction Only Price
Field.Description: Price at which the auction book would match using only Eligible Auction Orders

Message.Name: Auction Summary Message
Message.Description: Auction Summary messages are used to disseminate the results of an auction of a Cboe listed security.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Stock Symbol
Field.Description: Stock Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: Auction type values

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: Auction price.

Field.Name: Shares
Field.Description: Cumulative number of shares executed during the auction.

Message.Name: Auction Notification Message
Message.Description: Auction Notification messages are used to disseminate order details of an auction.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol right padded with spaces.

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction.

Field.Name: Auction Type
Field.Description: T or B

Field.Name: Side Indicator
Field.Description: B or S

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: For SUM this will reflect the NBBO price of the opposite side of the auction at the time of entry. For BAM this will reflect the limit price specified on the BAM order.

Field.Name: Contracts
Field.Description: Number of contracts available in the auction.

Field.Name: Customer Indicator
Field.Description: N or C

Field.Name: ParticipantID
Field.Description: Executing Broker (optional) of firm attributed to this quote

Field.Name: Auction End Offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last timestamp

Message.Name: Auction Cancel Message
Message.Description: Auction Cancel messages are used to disseminate the cancelation of an earlier Auction Notification message as a result of a user cancelation of the original order, a user modification request to change the price or increase the original order quantity, a fading of the NBBO or to cancel any remaining order quantity from the original Auction Notification following the auction termination.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction

Message.Name: Auction Trade Message
Message.Description: Auction Trade messages are used to disseminate executions resulting from an options auction.

Field.Name: Time offset
Field.Description: Nanosecond offset from last unit timestamp

Field.Name: Auction ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this auction

Field.Name: Execution ID
Field.Description: Day specific identifier assigned to this execution

Field.Name: Long Price
Field.Description: Trade price

Field.Name: Contracts
Field.Description: Number of contracts traded
